_about: Pages and keys of the generated profile for the MSFS 2024 default Cessna Citation CJ4, in the form of visionjet-sf50.json (see c172-g1000.json's _about: positions row,column; each key copies a real saved template and changes only the fields under 'set', 'shell' and the title). Positions, variables, events and formats are the tables of docs/cj4.md, built from docs/cj4-research.md's draft layout on its working values. There is no CJ4 input event list yet: standard K-events stand in for the input events, and a control whose only candidate is an input event is Empty. 15 pages: checklist 1,2 and MORE 1,2, 1,3 and 2,6 to 2,8 are Empty and kept for the keys and pages that use the WT21 key names, which have not been tested in the default CJ4. The pages views, simrate, vspeeds and xpdr are the C172 G1000 pages' keys as they are; compad is the VisionJet's COM pad page (press feedback by XL24-COMPAD.lua); radios (with hold to repeat by XL24-CJ4.lua) and the main page's AP, COM1, XPDR, ATC, MAP, CDI and BARO keys are the VisionJet's keys from before its main page changed (V-UX). Not yet sim-tested.

keys.empty: Fuel pump: the CJ4's pumps are readouts on SYSTEMS (docs/cj4-research.md, Main page)

pages.note: Trim as the C172's trim page with its aileron trim keys; hold to repeat on all six trim keys
Views as the C172's (camera state writes and readouts)
Checklist: the back key only; 1,2 is kept for the cursor control panel's checklist key

keys.empty: CKLST: kept for the cursor control panel's checklist key; it waits for a test of the WT21 key names in the default CJ4 (docs/cj4-research.md)
